newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium futures end mixed.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium futures end mixed.

text.p: Tokyo aluminium futures ended mixed in thin trade on Friday, after fluctuating in line with the yen/dollar exchange rate, local traders said.

All contracts gained during the day, as the yen's falls against the dollar offset the weaker London aluminium market on Thursday, but market participants couldn't find a clear direction, traders said.
"Light buying from individual investors supported some contracts," a brokerage house trader said.
Prices ranged from 0.1 yen lower to 0.9 yen higher, with the benchmark April 1998 contract up 0.5 yen at 190.3 yen per kg. Estimated volume was 1,316 lots.
Open interest of the yen-based aluminium futures was 18,112 lots as of June 19, against 18,381 lots as of June 2.
